picks.comment: The kitchen-sink plugin: 183 skills, 48 agents, 79 commands in one install. Overkill if you want surgical tools, but the right answer if you'd rather inherit a fully-furnished workshop than buy hammers one at a time.

Auto-captures every Claude Code session, compresses it, and re-injects the relevant slices into future sessions. The fix for 'Claude forgot what we built yesterday.' Its star count is climbing fast for a reason.

A single CLAUDE.md derived from Karpathy's notes on where LLM coding agents trip over themselves. Tiny footprint, opinionated guardrails — drop it in and watch your agent stop confidently shipping nonsense.
